title: Zoku Hatsukoi Monogatari: Shuugaku Ryokou
overview:
A coming-of-age dating simulation built around school trips. As Hiroya Kanzaki, you search for first love on class trips at four stages of life, with your childhood friend Yuka Takase always close by to lend support.

Plan each trip around study and training, manage your spending money to buy gifts, and choose your responses carefully when you talk with the girls. Win one girl's heart per playthrough to reach a happy ending.

- Disc 1: elementary school, a trip to Nikko and Toshogu Shrine
- Disc 2: junior high, a trip to Kiyomizu-dera in Kyoto
- Disc 3: high school, a trip to Megane Bridge in Nagasaki
- Disc 4: university and the spring break before it, a trip to the Little Mermaid statue in Denmark
- A fully voiced cast of heroines
- Sequel to Hatsukoi Monogatari

Rated for players 18 and over.
